aboutUs.title: About Us
aboutUs.subtitle: We don't just code. We understand your business.
aboutUs.bio: Dale Automations is led by Pablo Heckel, who holds a Bachelor's degree in Business Administration and an MBA. That combination of business education and technology is what sets us apart: we don't start with the code, we start by understanding how your operation works.
aboutUs.differentiator: First we understand your processes, identify what can be automated and what needs a dashboard. Then we design and build. The result: systems that actually solve problems, not technology for technology's sake.

understand.title: We understand your operation
understand.description: We sit down with you, map your processes, and find where there's friction, wasted time, or lack of visibility.

design.title: We design the system
design.description: We define the architecture, required integrations, and the dashboards you'll need to make decisions.

build.title: We build and integrate
build.description: We develop your system with modern technology, connect it to your existing tools, and get it running.

deliver.title: We deliver + support
deliver.description: Training, documentation, and ongoing support. Your system evolves with your business.
